45034.title: Concurrent change by another user fails the edit save with a message
provenance: This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-9315 and story SV-9318 (Story 3, Inline Edit Part - Tech View) and the Inline Add and Edit Parts on Work Order Lines specification version 16, section S3-E1, read on 31 August 2026.

before.custom_preconds:
1. In the top menu click “Work Orders”, then open a work order whose status is Estimate, Approved, In Progress, or Review (click its row in the list). Open its “Lines” tab. Each work order line has its own Parts section beneath it: the “Add Part” button sits in that section, and every part already on the line has an “edit” control at the right-hand end of its row — that control stays invisible until you move the mouse over the row.
2. Your user has the 'Work Order Line - Create and Edit' permission enabled. To check it: open “Settings”, click “Roles & Permissions” in the sidebar, then click the pencil on the role your user is on, and look for “Work Order Line - Create and Edit”.
3. Your “Work Orders → Work Order View Mode” permission is set to Tech View. To check or change it: open “Settings”, click “Roles & Permissions” in the sidebar, then click the pencil on the role your user is on, then set “Work Order View Mode” to Tech View.
4. The work order line already has at least one part listed in its Parts section (if not, add one first with “Add Part”).
before.custom_steps:
1. Open an edit row.
2. Have another user modify or delete the same part while your row is open.
3. Attempt to Save using the Save control on the inline row.
before.custom_expected:
1. The save fails and an alert is shown: “This part was changed by someone else. Refresh to see the latest.”

NOTE FOR THE TESTER: this needs a second person changing the same part at the same moment as you. If you can arrange that, run it; otherwise leave it Untested and tell the QA lead.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-9315 and story SV-9318 (Story 3, Inline Edit Part - Tech View) and the Inline Add and Edit Parts on Work Order Lines specification version 16, section S3-E1, read on 31 August 2026.

AUTOMATION: READY

provenance: This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-9315 and story SV-9319 (Story 4, Inline Add Part - Full View) and the Inline Add and Edit Parts on Work Order Lines specification version 16, section S4-E1, read on 31 August 2026.

before.custom_preconds:
1. In the top menu click “Work Orders”, then open a work order whose status is Estimate, Approved, In Progress, or Review (click its row in the list). Open its “Lines” tab. Each work order line has its own Parts section beneath it: the “Add Part” button sits in that section, and every part already on the line has an “edit” control at the right-hand end of its row — that control stays invisible until you move the mouse over the row.
2. Your user has the 'Work Order Line - Create and Edit' permission enabled. To check it: open “Settings”, click “Roles & Permissions” in the sidebar, then click the pencil on the role your user is on, and look for “Work Order Line - Create and Edit”.

before.custom_preconds:
1. In the top menu click “Work Orders”, then open a work order whose status is Estimate, Approved, In Progress, or Review (click its row in the list). Open its “Lines” tab. Each work order line has its own Parts section beneath it: the “Add Part” button sits in that section, and every part already on the line has an “edit” control at the right-hand end of its row — that control stays invisible until you move the mouse over the row.
2. Your user has the 'Work Order Line - Create and Edit' permission enabled. To check it: open “Settings”, click “Roles & Permissions” in the sidebar, then click the pencil on the role your user is on, and look for “Work Order Line - Create and Edit”.
